items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I didn’t even mention Miles, how much I learned from him.

ctx.x: Yeah. My father and mother had a vast music collection. So I heard everything from the OJ’s to the Temptations to Sly and the Family Stone to Miles Davis, Carlos Santana, John Coltrane, Ahmad Jamal, Les McCann and Eddie Harris, so all that music, which kind of shocked me, because when I got to college, a lot of the music that was just in my house, a lot of musicians hadn’t heard of it. But my father, a big jazz saxophonist lover, and particularly Gene Ammons. So I was about 13 and into the music, and again, a lot…
The decision to go to Berklee, I don’t know if at the time you would have thought this, what was the goal?
